title: ExCal: Optimization-Free Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection via Excess Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2610.35568v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce ExCal, a normal-only multivariate time series anomaly detector that combines raw state retrieval, a signal/derivative subspace, and robust statistics across temporal scales. Each expert map receives a high normality floor from the training prefix. During scoring, positive excess is retained, attenuated for broadly firing maps, and combined with a small rank term. The method fits reference memories and projections without gradient optimization or anomaly labels. Prevalence and ranks depend on the complete scored sequence, making inference batch and transductive rather than online. On 180 series from 17 TSB-AD-M families, ExCal obtains AUC-PR $0.421\pm0.37$ and VUS-PR $0.452\pm0.37$ over three seeds, ranking second among 24 methods. translated_title: ExCal：通过超额校准实现无需优化的多变量时间序列异常检测
translated_abstract: 我们提出ExCal，一种仅使用正常数据的多变量时间序列异常检测器，它结合了原始状态检索、信号/导数子空间以及跨时间尺度的稳健统计。每个专家映射从训练前缀中获得较高的正常性下限。在评分过程中，保留正超额部分，对广泛激活的映射进行衰减，并与一个较小的秩项相结合。该方法无需梯度优化或异常标签即可拟合参考记忆和投影。流行度和秩依赖于完整的评分序列，使得推理是批处理和直推式的，而非在线式的。在来自17个TSB-AD-M系列的180个序列上，ExCal在三个随机种子下获得AUC-PR 0.421±0.37和VUS-PR 0.452±0.37，在24种方法中排名第二。经Holm校正的配对检验显示，在两个主要指标上与AxonAD或StreamVAE（TSB-AD-M上领先的两种非预训练方法）均无显著差异，同时发现显著……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ExCal是一种无需梯度优化和异常标签、仅使用正常数据的多变量时间序列异常检测方法，通过结合原始状态检索、信号/导数子空间和跨时间尺度的稳健统计，在TSB-AD-M基准的24种方法中排名第二。
en_tdlr: ExCal is an optimization-free, normal-only multivariate time series anomaly detector that combines raw state retrieval, signal/derivative subspaces, and robust statistics across temporal scales, ranking second among 24 methods on the TSB-AD-M benchmark.
